Sure bhai 👇 — here is a complete working version of websocket_ltp_stream_custom.py using the latest smartapi-python SDK (v1.5.5) for Angel One:

✅ websocket_ltp_stream_custom.py

python
from smartapi import SmartConnect
import pyotp
import time
import threading
import json

# === CONFIG ===
API_KEY = "your_api_key_here"
CLIENT_CODE = "your_client_code_here"
PIN = "your_2fa_pin_here"  # like '123456'
TOTP_SECRET = "your_totp_secret_here"  # from SmartAPI TOTP setup

# === LOGIN ===
totp = pyotp.TOTP(TOTP_SECRET).now()
obj = SmartConnect(api_key=API_KEY)
data = obj.generateSession(client_id=CLIENT_CODE, password=PIN, totp=totp)

if data.get("status") != True:
    print("Login failed:", data)
    exit()

auth_token = data["data"]["jwtToken"]
refresh_token = data["data"]["refreshToken"]
feed_token = obj.getfeedToken()
print("Login successful!")

# === SETUP WEBSOCKET ===
from smartapi.ws.websocket import WebSocket

socket_opened = False

def on_open(wsapp):
    global socket_opened
    socket_opened = True
    print("WebSocket connected.")

    # Subscribe to token
    wsapp.subscribe([
        {
            "action": 1,
            "params": {
                "mode": 1,  # 1 = LTP
                "tokenList": [{
                    "exchangeType": 1,  # 1 = NSE
                    "tokens": ["3045"]  # Example: 3045 = RELIANCE
                }]
            }
        }
    ])

def on_data(wsapp, message):
    data = json.loads(message)
    print("Received:", data)

def on_error(wsapp, error):
    print("WebSocket Error:", error)

def on_close(wsapp):
    print("WebSocket closed.")

# Start WebSocket
ws = WebSocket(
    feed_token=feed_token,
    client_code=CLIENT_CODE,
    api_key=API_KEY
)

ws.on_open = on_open
ws.on_data = on_data
ws.on_error = on_error
ws.on_close = on_close

# Run WebSocket in thread
t = threading.Thread(target=ws.connect)
t.start()

# Keep main thread alive
try:
    while True:
        time.sleep(1)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    print("Exiting...")
    ws.close()

from SmartApi.smartConnect import SmartConnect
from SmartApi.smartWebSocket import SmartWebSocket
import pyotp
import time

# ==== 🔐 LOGIN CREDENTIALS ====
API_KEY = "Shcr9brZ"
CLIENT_CODE = "ASIFA1491"
PASSWORD = "9986"
TOTP_SECRET = "6VDXFQ23A54VT6AISO6XKYX5NE"  # This should be a string

# ==== 🔐 Generate TOTP ====
totp = pyotp.TOTP(TOTP_SECRET)
totp_code = totp.now()

# ==== 📲 Create session ====
obj = SmartConnect(api_key=API_KEY)
data = obj.generateSession(CLIENT_CODE, PASSWORD, totp_code)

auth_token = data['data']['jwtToken']
refresh_token = data['data']['refreshToken']
feed_token = obj.getfeedToken()

print("✅ Login Success")
print("Feed Token:", feed_token)

# ==== 📡 WebSocket connection ====
sws = SmartWebSocket(FEED_TOKEN=feed_token, CLIENT_CODE=CLIENT_CODE)

# You can change this to any token you want, like RELIANCE: 2885
tokens = ["nse_cm|2885"]  # INFY token

def on_open(wsapp):
    print("📡 Socket opened. Subscribing to token(s)...")
    sws.subscribe(token_list=tokens)

def on_data(wsapp, message):
    print("📊 Live Data:", message)

def on_error(wsapp, error):
    print("❌ Error:", error)

def on_close(wsapp):
    print("🔌 Socket closed")

sws.on_open = on_open
sws.on_data = on_data
sws.on_error = on_error
sws.on_close = on_close

print("🚀 Starting WebSocket...")
sws.connect()
